packages.label_en: Advance-and-Retreat and the Breaking of the Clay Vessel
packages.reason: All the concepts in this Torah are different expressions of a single structural phenomenon: a revelation that is simultaneously concealed — the ratzoh-vashov (advance and retreat) dynamic. The revealed connection between souls at betrothal, the spark produced by breaking a clay vessel, and the flash of lightning in Ezekiel's vision are explicitly equated by the Rebbe as bechinot of each other. None produces the other causally; each is a different face of the same momentary-and-transient illumination. The polarity is neutral because this Torah describes a metaphysical/structural pattern — the oscillation between hiddenness and revelation — with no good-vs-evil opposition. The breaking of the vessel is itself the hint (רֶמֶז) to this pattern, making the physical act and the cosmic principle two expressions of the same reality.
